title: FableCraft
description: FableCraft adds magical blocks and tracking tools to Minecraft, letting you bounce higher, grow crops instantly, and keep tabs on anything that moves (along with other things!)
body: # FableCraft A Minecraft mod that adds a handful of quirky, magical items and blocks to spice up your adventures. Built for Fabric 1.21.10. ## Features ### Bouncy Wool Ever wanted to turn your base into a trampoline park? This wool block launches you skyward when you land on it. The harder you fall, the higher you bounce. Perfect for parkour courses or just messing around with friends. #### Crafting Recipe ![Bouncy Wool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00479ee23ff7ccfdf4c564dd9fdb853791beb60c.png) ### Glimmer Lantern A mystical lantern that does more than just light up the night. Every few seconds, it pulses out a wave that makes nearby creatures glow for a bit, so you can spot that creeper lurking in the shadows. Hang it from the ceiling or place it on the ground - your choice. #### Crafting Recipe ![Glimmer Lantern](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b22102080e8a147ac1c28411eed5994cc111d53d.png) ### Seed Bomb Tired of waiting for your crops to grow? Toss one of these bad boys and watch your wheat, carrots, and potatoes instantly ripen in a 5-block radius. Works on pretty much any vanilla crop. Your inner farmer will thank you. #### Crafting Recipe ![Seed Bomb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed93a23cce45120420b46b3bd74f5300d464ed3c.png) ### Tracker Right-click any mob or player with this item to start tracking them. You'll see their distance and exact location in your action bar, plus they'll glow periodically so you never lose sight of them. Great for keeping tabs on your pet wolf or that friend who keeps wandering off. #### Crafting Recipe ![Tracker](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62df5efd69fc0b47a3ccf32aa65daa2d943cc570.png) ### Umbrella Hold this in either hand while falling and you'll drift down slowly like Mary Poppins. No fall damage, plenty of style. Jump off cliffs with confidence. #### Crafting Recipe ![Umbrella](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da637330f9e3d349f43dca60d93765cb48881ffd.png) ## Installation 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 1.21.10 2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 3. Drop both Fabric API and FableCraft into your `mods` folder 4. Launch the game and you're good to go ## Technical Stuff - **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.10 - **Loader:** Fabric 0.17.2+ - **Dependencies:** Fabric API 0.135.0+ - **Java Version:** 21
